# AI Tools in Pakistan 2026: Full Directory of All Subscriptions, PKR Prices & API Credits


Every AI subscription sold by AI Tools Pak in one place — 32 tools across 8 categories, with full descriptions, current PKR prices (PKR 400 to PKR 45,000, average PKR 4,322), comparison tables, a complete price index and direct buy links — plus a large guide to AI API credits for businesses and developers.

Published: August 4, 2026. Last updated: August 4, 2026. Reviewed by AI Tools Pak Editorial.
      
      
        
          

## What is on this page


This is the single largest reference for AI tools in Pakistan on this site. It contains: (1) the complete product directory with every tool's full details, (2) category overviews, (3) an AI assistants comparison table, (4) the full price index of all 32 tools, (5) a step-by-step buying guide for Pakistan, (6) a complete guide to AI API credits, (7) a glossary of AI terms, and (8) a 25-question FAQ. Every price is in PKR and every tool links to its product page and WhatsApp order button.

## AI API Credits for Businesses & Developers (Complete Guide)


Beyond ready-made subscriptions, AI Tools Pak also supplies AI API credits at wholesale pricing for teams that build their own AI applications. API credits let your software call hosted AI models directly, instead of using consumer apps. This section explains what API credits are, how tokens and pricing work, which providers are available, who should buy them and exactly how to order in Pakistan.


### What are AI API credits?


AI API credits are prepaid usage for calling hosted AI models over an API (Application Programming Interface). Instead of logging into ChatGPT or Claude as a user, your application sends requests to the model over the internet and pays per token or per request. AI Tools Pak supplies bulk token packages at competitive wholesale pricing, with custom quotes based on your monthly token usage, chosen models, throughput and long-term requirements.


### What is a token?


A token is the unit AI models use to measure text. A model reads and writes text in tokens: roughly 1 token is about 3/4 of a word in English, so 1,000 tokens is roughly 750 words. Every API request consumes input tokens (the prompt) and output tokens (the answer). Larger prompts, longer answers and bigger models consume more tokens. Your monthly token volume is therefore the main driver of API credit pricing.


### How bulk API credit pricing works


We do not publish one fixed price because API credits are quoted around your usage. Your quote depends on:
            

- Monthly token usage — from modest to multi-billion token scale

- Selected AI models and providers — different models have different cost profiles

- Required throughput and concurrency — how many parallel requests your app makes

- Long-term supply and recurring order needs — committed volume gets better terms
            

Message us on WhatsApp with your expected monthly usage and the models you need, and we will send a custom quote and delivery timeline.


### API providers and model families available

            
              
                Supported AI API providers
                ProviderModel familiesTypical use
                
                  OpenAIGPT-4 and newer GPT chat models, o-series reasoning modelsGeneral assistants, chat apps, agents, content generation
                  AnthropicClaude (Opus, Sonnet, Haiku) API modelsLong writing, careful reasoning, coding, document analysis
                  GoogleGemini Flash and Gemini Pro API modelsMultimodal input, high-volume tasks, cost-sensitive apps
                  DeepSeekDeepSeek Chat and DeepSeek ReasonerCoding support and budget-friendly high-volume workloads
                  xAIGrok API modelsReal-time and conversational AI features
                  MetaLlama API modelsOpen-model applications, custom fine-tuning projects
                  AlibabaQwen API modelsMultilingual apps and cost-efficient chat systems
                
              
            

Model names, access methods and availability can change. Confirm the exact current model list and regional availability on WhatsApp before payment.


### Who should buy AI API credits


AI API credits are a fit for teams building:
            

- AI SaaS platforms — product features powered by AI models

- AI chatbots and customer support — answering customers at scale

- AI agents and automation — autonomous workflows, data processing pipelines

- Coding assistants — code completion, review and generation tools

- Content generation and research systems — articles, summaries, translation, analysis

- Education and e-commerce — tutoring bots, product descriptions, recommendation engines
            

We support requirements from millions of tokens to multi-billion token usage depending on your project and agreement. We avoid misleading "unlimited" promises because real AI providers set usage limits; we quote honest, workable capacity for your use case.

## Glossary of AI terms

            

- API — Application Programming Interface — the way software talks to an AI model over the internet.

- API credits — Prepaid usage for calling hosted AI models; consumed per token or per request.

- Token — The text unit AI models measure usage in; roughly 1 token equals about 3/4 of an English word.

- LLM — Large Language Model — an AI model trained on huge text data that generates and understands language.

- Prompt — The text or instructions you send to an AI model.

- Subscription — A recurring plan (usually monthly) that gives access to an AI service.

- Private access — A subscription accessed by you alone, with your own credentials.

- WhatsApp activation — Delivery method where your plan is activated and set up via WhatsApp.

- Throughput — How many API requests your application can make in a given time.

- Concurrency — How many parallel API requests run at the same time.

- Multimodal — Models that can process text, images, audio and other input types.

- Reasoning model — A model that works through a problem step by step before answering.

- Fine-tuning — Customising a base model on your own data for a specific task.

- Wholesale pricing — Bulk pricing for larger volumes of tokens or services.

# Canva Pro Price in Pakistan: Cost in PKR and Buying Guide


The official Canva Pro price is USD 12.99 per month, roughly PKR 3,600–3,800 depending on the exchange rate. This guide explains what you actually get, how Pakistani prices compare and how to buy safely.

## Canva Pro price in Pakistan: official price and PKR conversion


Canva Pro is officially priced at USD 12.99 per month (or USD 119.99 per year) on canva.com. At typical Pakistani exchange rates that is approximately PKR 3,600–3,800 per month. The exact PKR amount changes with the exchange rate, so always confirm the current payable amount in PKR before paying.

Prices from local Pakistani sellers often differ from the official canva.com price because of access method (personal account, team seat or activation), payment method and seller margins. A lower price is not a problem by itself &#8212; the problem is paying before the access model, duration and warranty are clear.

## What Canva Pro includes

          

- Unlimited premium design tools, magic resize and background remover

- Brand Kit to store logos, colors and fonts

- 1 TB of cloud storage and 100+ premium fonts

- Priority support and 100,000+ premium templates

- Canva Magic Studio AI features (Magic Write, Magic Edit and more)
          

## Canva Free vs Canva Pro in Pakistan


Canva Free is enough for occasional designs: basic templates, limited storage and standard uploads. Canva Pro adds the premium tools, Brand Kit, background remover and AI features that freelancers and small businesses need daily. If you design social posts, pitch decks, thumbnails or client creatives every week, Pro usually pays for itself.

## What Pakistani buyers should ask

          

- What is the exact current price in PKR?

- Is the access private, shared, account-based or activation-based?

- How long will the plan remain active?

- What information is needed for activation?

- What happens if activation cannot be completed?

- How long does support remain available after delivery?
          

## Safety checklist


Do not share your email password. Confirm whether the access is private, shared, account-based or activation-based. Ask what support is available after delivery. Keep order messages in WhatsApp so you have the confirmed price, duration and warranty in writing.

Also check whether the seller clearly says they are not an official partner unless they can prove authorization. Transparent wording is safer than exaggerated claims like lifetime unlimited access or official reseller status without evidence.

# Claude Pro vs ChatGPT Plus for Pakistani Students


Compare Claude Pro and ChatGPT Plus for study, writing, research and coding workflows in Pakistan.
      
      
        

## The short answer

ChatGPT Plus is often the safer first paid AI tool if you want one assistant for many tasks. Claude Pro is attractive when your work involves longer reading, careful rewriting and structured explanation.

For Pakistani students, the best choice depends on the work you repeat every week. If your tasks include short questions, mixed subjects, coding help and quick writing, ChatGPT Plus is easier to justify. If your tasks include long notes, research drafts and detailed explanations, Claude Pro deserves a serious look.

Published: July 14, 2026. Last updated: July 16, 2026. Prices last verified from AI Tools Pak catalog on July 16, 2026.

## For assignments and notes

Students should not use either tool to submit copied work. Use AI to plan, explain, summarize, check grammar and improve clarity. Your own understanding still matters, especially for exams, viva questions and project defense.

A better workflow is to paste your rough outline, ask for missing points, then rewrite the answer in your own words. This makes AI useful without turning the assignment into copied text.

## For coding

Both tools can explain errors, suggest approaches and review code. Claude can be useful for reading longer files, while ChatGPT is a strong general coding helper. Test your actual workflow before buying a longer plan.

## For research and long documents

Claude Pro is often preferred by users who work with longer material, structured summaries and careful tone. ChatGPT Plus is better when you need a broad assistant for brainstorming, debugging, content and everyday study questions.

## Budget decision

- Choose one tool first instead of buying both immediately.
- Start with the plan that solves your most repeated study problem.
- Confirm duration, access model and refund condition before payment.
- Upgrade later only if the tool is clearly helping your weekly work.

## Buying safely

Confirm the duration, price, access model and support policy before payment. Avoid any seller who asks for your email password or promises impossible unlimited usage.

Keep the WhatsApp confirmation saved. It should mention price in PKR, access method, delivery estimate and support window. This protects you more than a vague discount claim.

A writer needs different tools than a video editor or developer. Do not buy every popular AI subscription at once. Pick one tool that directly improves your paid work this month.

For freelancers in Pakistan, the best AI tool is the one that helps you deliver faster, communicate better or raise the quality of your portfolio. A subscription is only worth it if it supports a service you can sell or a workflow you repeat often.

## Writing and client communication

ChatGPT Plus and Claude Pro can help with proposals, research outlines, email replies, captions and rewriting. The best use is not copying output, but turning rough ideas into polished client-ready drafts.

Use AI to prepare first drafts, scope documents, FAQs, Upwork proposals and social captions. Then edit for your own voice, client details and local context. This keeps the work useful instead of generic.

## Design and content

Canva Pro is useful for freelancers making social posts, presentation decks and simple brand assets. Pair it with an AI writing tool if your work includes both content and visuals.

## Video, voice and coding tools

Video freelancers should compare CapCut Pro for editing with AI video tools for generation. Voice creators can look at tools like ElevenLabs when narration or dubbing is part of the service. Developers should only buy coding tools if they already have projects where faster debugging, planning or documentation will save time.

## Suggested starter stacks

- Writer or marketer: ChatGPT Plus or Claude Pro first.
- Designer or social media manager: Canva Pro plus one writing assistant.
- Video creator: CapCut Pro first, then test AI video generation if needed.
- Developer: one general AI assistant before niche coding subscriptions.

## Buying advice

Choose plans with clear duration, support and refund rules. If you are testing a tool, start with the shortest practical duration before committing to a longer plan.

Do not judge only by discount. Ask what access model is used, how delivery works, what support covers and what happens if activation fails. Avoid sellers who need your email password or make official-partner claims without proof.

# How to Choose an AI Subscription Safely


A safety checklist for buying AI subscriptions in Pakistan without sharing passwords or falling for misleading claims.

Published: July 14, 2026. Last updated: July 16, 2026. Reviewed by AI Tools Pak Editorial.
      
      
        

## Ask the right questions

Before payment, ask for the exact product name, plan duration, current PKR price, access model, delivery estimate, support hours and refund conditions.

A safe seller should be able to explain the order clearly before asking for payment. If the answers are vague, wait. The cheapest offer is not useful if you do not know what will be delivered or how support works.

## Avoid risky claims

Be careful with sellers who claim official partnership without proof, promise lifetime access for products that bill monthly, or refuse to explain how activation works.

Also be careful with phrases like unlimited access, guaranteed forever, no limits, official reseller or special admin access unless there is written proof. Most serious AI subscriptions have rules, billing periods and usage limits.

## Protect your account

Never share your email password. Use written WhatsApp confirmation for the order terms. Keep screenshots or chat history until the warranty period is over.

If activation needs an email or account step, ask exactly what will happen and why. A seller should not need your personal inbox password. Use account security settings and keep recovery options under your control.

## Red flags before payment

- No clear business name or support number
- No refund condition before activation
- Pressure to pay immediately
- Claims of official partnership without proof
- Refusal to explain access model or delivery time
- Request for your email password

## Start small

If you are unsure, buy a shorter duration first. Upgrade later when the tool is clearly useful for your work.

## Keep your order record

Save the WhatsApp chat with price, duration, product name, access type, delivery estimate and support window. If the plan cannot be delivered, this written record makes the refund or support conversation much simpler.

- FAQ
- Refund Policy

### free vs paid ai tools
Buying guide

# Free vs Paid AI Tools: What Is the Difference?


Understand when free AI tools are enough and when paid AI subscriptions make sense for users in Pakistan.

Published: July 14, 2026. Last updated: July 16, 2026. Reviewed by AI Tools Pak Editorial.
      
      
        

## Free tools are good for testing

Free AI tools are useful for learning prompts, trying basic writing, testing ideas and deciding whether a workflow is worth paying for.

For many Pakistani users, free tools are enough at the beginning. They help you learn what AI can do, test different prompts and understand whether the tool fits your study, freelance or business workflow.

## Paid tools can save time

Paid plans may offer better limits, faster access, stronger models, extra design features, video tools or higher usage caps. The value depends on whether the tool helps you earn, study or create more effectively.

A paid plan is easier to justify when it saves billable time, improves client output, helps you ship content faster or supports a task you repeat every week. It is harder to justify when you only use it once or twice a month.

## Do not pay for everything

A freelancer might need one writing assistant and one design tool. A student might only need one AI assistant. A content creator might prioritize video editing instead.

## Common paid-plan advantages

- Higher usage limits or faster responses
- More advanced models or features
- Better export, design, video or voice tools
- Access to team, brand or productivity features
- More predictable availability for daily work

## When free is enough

Stay free if you are still learning, only need occasional help, cannot explain the weekly task it will improve, or do not yet know which tool fits your work. Buying too early can waste money.

## How to decide

Write down the task you repeat every week. If a paid tool improves that task enough to justify the price, it may be worth buying. If not, stay with free options.

# Cursor vs GitHub Copilot for Pakistani Developers


Cursor Pro has an official price of USD 20 per month (about PKR 5,600), while GitHub Copilot Pro is officially USD 10 per month (about PKR 2,800). Both are excellent, but they suit different workflows, so this guide helps Pakistani developers pick the right one.

Published: August 5, 2026. Last updated: August 5, 2026. Reviewed by AI Tools Pak Editorial.
      
      
        

## Cursor vs GitHub Copilot: the short answer


Cursor is an AI-first editor built for agentic coding, deep context and multi-file edits. GitHub Copilot works inside the editor you already use, adding autocomplete and chat everywhere.

If you want an AI agent driving whole tasks, choose Cursor. If you want a smart assistant inside Visual Studio Code, JetBrains or other IDEs, choose Copilot.

## Official prices in PKR


Both tools are billed in USD on their official websites. Using roughly PKR 280 per USD, here is what the Pro plans cost.
          ToolOfficial pricePKR equivalentBest forCursor ProUSD 20 per month≈ PKR 5,600Agentic coding and multi-file editsGitHub Copilot ProUSD 10 per month≈ PKR 2,800Autocomplete and chat in any IDE

## Cursor: agentic coding with deep context


Cursor understands your whole project, not just the open file. Its agentic features plan and execute multi-file edits, run terminal commands and iterate on tasks with far less hand-holding.

- Project-wide context for accurate changes
- Agent mode that plans and executes multi-file edits
- Built-in chat, composer-style workflows and model choice
- Official price USD 20 per month (≈ PKR 5,600)

## GitHub Copilot: autocomplete everywhere


Copilot is less opinionated: it brings AI to the editor you already know. Autocomplete, inline chat and code review work across Visual Studio Code, Visual Studio, JetBrains and more, which suits developers who do not want to switch editors.

- Works inside your existing editor and IDE
- Fast autocomplete and inline chat
- Great for quick fixes and boilerplate
- Official price USD 10 per month (≈ PKR 2,800)

## Which suits freelancers and teams in Pakistan?


Freelancers billing per project often prefer Cursor because agentic coding finishes multi-file tasks faster, which means more billable output per hour. Teams on a budget, or shops standardized on an editor like Visual Studio Code, usually find Copilot at half the price the smarter spend.

Many developers run Copilot daily for autocomplete and bring in Cursor for heavy refactors. If you can afford only one, match the tool to your dominant workflow rather than the hype.

# Gemini vs GPT-5 in 2026: Which AI Assistant Is Better for Pakistan?


Google Gemini and OpenAI GPT-5 are the two assistants most Pakistani users reach for first. This head-to-head covers reasoning, coding, images, Urdu support and what each plan actually costs in PKR.

Published: August 6, 2026. Last updated: August 6, 2026. Reviewed by AI Tools Pak Editorial.
      
      
        

## The two assistants in 2026


Both Google and OpenAI now lead with flagship models: Gemini inside the Google app, Gmail and Workspace, and GPT-5 inside ChatGPT. Both offer a genuinely useful free tier, which is why most people in Pakistan start without paying anything.

The paid tiers are nearly identical in price: Google AI Pro (Gemini Advanced) is officially USD 19.99 per month, and ChatGPT Plus is officially USD 20 per month. At the approximate PKR 280 per USD rate, both land around PKR 5,600 per month.

- Gemini free: chat, search-linked answers, image generation and Workspace integration at no cost
- ChatGPT free: GPT-5 at limited usage, plus browsing, file uploads and DALL·E 3 image generation

## Reasoning and coding


GPT-5 is the stronger all-round reasoner. It handles multi-step math, logic puzzles, exam-style questions and careful planning tasks with fewer slips, which makes it popular with Pakistani students preparing for entry tests and professional certifications.

Gemini is no slouch, and its real edge is integration: it reads your Gmail, Docs and Drive, so it can summarize long threads and draft replies in context. For coding, GPT-5 is generally more reliable for debugging and refactoring, while Gemini is handy when your code lives in Google Drive or you want quick explanations alongside Google search results.

## Image generation and context length


Both can generate images. Gemini's native image generation is fast and understands long prompts, while GPT-5 uses DALL·E 3 inside ChatGPT Plus. For posters, thumbnails and product visuals both produce usable results; DALL·E 3 has an edge on text inside images, and Gemini wins on speed in the free tier.

Context length is where Gemini pulls ahead: Google AI Pro offers a very large 1 million token window, so you can paste entire books, long legal documents or full codebases in one go. GPT-5 handles long conversations comfortably, but the 1M-token window remains a Gemini advantage for document-heavy work.

## Urdu and English support


Both assistants handle Urdu well, including Roman Urdu (Urdu written in English letters), which is how most Pakistanis type on WhatsApp.

- Gemini: strong Urdu translation and natural output, plus voice input in the app
- GPT-5: very natural mixed Urdu-English replies and good comprehension of Urdu slang

For client work in English, both are professional enough for emails, proposals and reports. For Urdu content, either works; the choice often comes down to which ecosystem you already live in.

# Perplexity vs ChatGPT Search: Which AI Search Engine for Pakistan?


Perplexity and ChatGPT Search both answer questions with live web sources, but they are built differently. This guide compares citations, follow-up research and what each costs in PKR.

Published: August 6, 2026. Last updated: August 6, 2026. Reviewed by AI Tools Pak Editorial.
      
      
        

## Two ways to search with AI


Perplexity is a search engine first: every answer comes with numbered sources you can open and check. ChatGPT Search is a feature inside ChatGPT: you get an answer, then a set of source links, all inside the same chat where you can keep asking follow-ups.

Both are free to start. Perplexity's free tier gives a limited number of searches per day, while ChatGPT free includes browsing with usage caps. Paid plans cost the same: Perplexity Pro is officially USD 20 per month and ChatGPT Plus is officially USD 20 per month, both around PKR 5,600 at the approximate PKR 280 rate.

## Citation quality


Perplexity is the stronger citator. Its answers are built around sources, with inline numbers next to every claim and a clean source panel on the side. That structure is a lifesaver for university assignments, research proposals and any work where you must show where information came from.

- Perplexity: numbered inline citations, a source panel, and follow-up questions that stay grounded in the cited pages
- ChatGPT Search: sources shown as links under the answer, better for conversational exploration than formal citation

If your supervisor or client asks where a claim came from, Perplexity answers faster and more convincingly.

## Follow-up research and depth


Perplexity shines at iterative research: explain a topic, compare two options, then ask what changed last year. Each turn stays grounded in fresh web results. Pro adds file uploads, more search credits and access to multiple frontier models for the same query.

ChatGPT Search is better when the answer feeds into a deliverable. You research, then immediately ask for a summary, an email, a report or a spreadsheet in the same thread. For freelancers, that research-to-output flow saves real time.

Both are excellent at coding. Claude Sonnet is known for clean, well-structured code and careful refactoring, with a large context window that suits reviewing big codebases. GPT-5 is also strong, with broad tooling and integrations that make it convenient inside workflows.

# Best AI Chatbots for Students in 2026 (Pakistan Guide)


ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, DeepSeek, Perplexity and Grok — which chatbot should a Pakistani student actually use for notes, essays, math and exam prep in 2026?

Published: August 6, 2026. Last updated: August 6, 2026. Reviewed by AI Tools Pak Editorial.
      
      
        

## The six chatbots that matter


All six are free to start, which makes them the safest first choice for any student budget. The differences show up in daily use: one is better at math, another at long essays, another at Urdu.

- ChatGPT — the default; the strongest overall balance of writing, math and coding.
- Gemini — generous free tier and deep Google Docs and Drive integration.
- Claude — careful long-form writing and structured study notes.
- DeepSeek — fully free chat with strong reasoning and solid Urdu/English switching.
- Perplexity — cited answers for research projects and MCQs.
- Grok — real-time topics and quick summaries for current affairs.

## Notes, summaries and exam prep


Paste a lecture transcript or a chapter and ask for structured notes, flashcards and past-paper style questions.

- ChatGPT and Gemini are best for turning messy lecture notes into clean summaries and flashcards.
- Perplexity shines for fact-checked revision on current topics.
- DeepSeek handles long past papers without hitting limits, because it is free.

## Essays and writing help


Use chatbots to outline, argue and proofread — never to hand in raw AI text. Pakistani universities check for AI content, so treat the output as a draft you rework.

- Claude produces the most structured, well-argued first drafts for essays.
- ChatGPT is faster for short paragraphs, emails and applications.
- Grammarly (AI Tools Pak price: PKR 833, 1 month) catches grammar the chatbot misses.

## Math and reasoning


Ask the chatbot to show every step, then verify by hand — models still slip on long calculations.

- ChatGPT and Gemini handle calculus, statistics and word problems with step-by-step working.
- DeepSeek's reasoning mode is excellent for tricky physics and math — and free.
- For handwritten problems, the Gemini app lets you snap a photo of the question.

## Urdu, English and everyday study


All six handle Urdu to some degree, but quality varies.

- DeepSeek and Gemini give the most natural Urdu/English mixing for explanations.
- Perplexity answers in English but can summarize Urdu sources.
- For bilingual flashcards and vocabulary lists, ChatGPT works well in both scripts.

# Best AI Agents in 2026: Top Agentic AI Tools to Know


Chatbots reply; agents act. Here are the agentic AI tools worth knowing in 2026, and how Pakistani businesses can use them for orders, WhatsApp replies and data entry.

Published: August 6, 2026. Last updated: August 6, 2026. Reviewed by AI Tools Pak Editorial.
      
      
        

## What agentic AI means in 2026


An AI agent does not just answer — it plans, uses tools and completes multi-step tasks with less hand-holding: checking an inbox, updating a sheet, sending a reply.

- Agents can browse, run code, call APIs and pass results between steps.
- They work best on narrow, repeatable jobs with clear rules and human checkpoints.
- Cost is mostly token usage, so budgets matter (more below).

## The top agentic AI tools


These are the tools getting real use in 2026. On price, we stay strict: n8n and the open-source frameworks are free, and commercial agent features are priced on the official pages — no guesswork here.

- ChatGPT agents/tasks — scheduled and multi-step tasks inside ChatGPT; included with ChatGPT plans (check the official pricing page).
- Claude computer use — Claude operates a computer-style interface to click, type and fill forms (check the official pricing page).
- Gemini agents — Google's agents wired into Workspace for email, sheets and docs (check the official pricing page).
- n8n AI agents — free and open-source for self-hosting (official); the hosted cloud is paid (check the official pricing page).
- LangChain and LlamaIndex — open-source frameworks developers use to build custom agents.
- AutoGPT — open-source autonomous agent you run yourself.
- Browser automation agents — tools that navigate websites and extract or fill data (check the official pricing page).

## What Pakistani businesses are automating


The practical wins in 2026 are boring, repeatable tasks that eat staff hours.

- Order handling — an agent reads WhatsApp or email orders, checks stock and builds a confirmed order list.
- WhatsApp replies — instant answers to price, delivery and stock questions, with a human handoff for complaints.
- Data entry — invoices, student records and leads moved from screenshots and PDFs into Google Sheets or Excel.

## Token budgets and API credits


Agents burn tokens fast: one multi-step task can use more tokens than a month of chatting. Before building anything, estimate the monthly cost.

- Set a per-task token budget and a hard monthly cap.
- Use cheaper models for simple steps and stronger models only for reasoning-heavy ones.
- Compare official API prices or buy API credits in Pakistan from a local supplier to keep costs predictable in PKR.

## Build it yourself or hire it done


If you have technical staff, n8n or AutoGPT on your own server gives the cheapest long-term setup. If you do not, do not let the project die — for hands-off workflow setup, local AI automation services handle the integration, from WhatsApp bots to order pipelines, for a fixed fee.

# Midjourney Price in Pakistan: Cost in PKR for 2026


Midjourney is officially priced at USD 10 to USD 120 per month — roughly PKR 2,800 to PKR 33,600 at the ~PKR 280/USD rate. This guide covers every plan, how to pay from Pakistan and the free alternatives worth trying first.

Published: August 6, 2026. Last updated: August 6, 2026. Reviewed by AI Tools Pak Editorial.
      
      
        

## Midjourney official price in USD and PKR


Midjourney sells monthly subscriptions directly on midjourney.com. The official list prices are USD 10 (Basic), USD 30 (Standard), USD 60 (Pro) and USD 120 (Mega) per month. The PKR figures below are approximations at the ~PKR 280/USD rate — the exact amount you pay moves with the exchange rate, so always confirm the current PKR total before paying.
          PlanOfficial USD pricePKR approx (monthly)Basic$10/monthPKR 2,800Standard$30/monthPKR 8,400Pro$60/monthPKR 16,800Mega$120/monthPKR 33,600

Annual billing works out to roughly 20% less than paying monthly: about PKR 2,240 per month equivalent on Basic, PKR 6,720 on Standard, PKR 13,440 on Pro and PKR 26,880 on Mega — again, all approximate.

## What each Midjourney plan includes


Every paid plan includes access to Midjourney's image generator through the web editor and Discord. The tiers differ in monthly generation allowance and queue speed, so pick based on volume rather than price alone.

- Basic: a limited number of fast generations per month with a slower queue — enough to test the tool properly
- Standard: the most popular tier, with more fast GPU time plus unlimited relaxed-mode generations
- Pro: significantly more fast GPU time, plus stealth mode for private generations
- Mega: the largest allowance for high-volume production, aimed at studios and heavy creators

## How to pay for Midjourney from Pakistan


Midjourney bills in USD and needs an international payment method. Many Pakistani debit cards are blocked for foreign online transactions, so the card gets declined at checkout even when the account itself works. # DeepSeek API Price in Pakistan: PKR Cost Guide 2026


DeepSeek's API is one of the cheapest ways to run AI in your own apps: deepseek-chat starts at USD 0.27 per 1M input tokens, about PKR 76 at the ~PKR 280/USD rate. Here is the full official price list, what it costs in PKR and how to pay for credits from Pakistan.

Published: August 6, 2026. Last updated: August 6, 2026. Reviewed by AI Tools Pak Editorial.
      
      
        

## DeepSeek API official pricing (platform.deepseek.com)


DeepSeek publishes its API prices on platform.deepseek.com. You pay per token, and input tokens are billed differently depending on whether they hit the cache. Output tokens always cost more than input tokens.
          ModelInput (cache miss)Input (cache hit)Outputdeepseek-chat$0.27 / 1M tokens$0.07 / 1M tokens$1.10 / 1M tokensdeepseek-reasoner$0.55 / 1M tokens$0.14 / 1M tokens$2.19 / 1M tokens

1M tokens is roughly the size of a long novel, so a typical chatbot session uses a small fraction of that. The DeepSeek web and app chat remain free — the API is a separate, paid service for developers.

## What 1M tokens costs in PKR (worked example)


At the ~PKR 280/USD rate (approximate, and it moves daily), here is the arithmetic on the official prices:

- deepseek-chat input, cache miss: USD 0.27 × 280 ≈ PKR 76 per 1M tokens
- deepseek-chat input, cache hit: USD 0.07 × 280 ≈ PKR 20 per 1M tokens
- deepseek-chat output: USD 1.10 × 280 ≈ PKR 308 per 1M tokens
- deepseek-reasoner input, cache miss: USD 0.55 × 280 ≈ PKR 154 per 1M tokens
- deepseek-reasoner output: USD 2.19 × 280 ≈ PKR 613 per 1M tokens

A typical session mixing 1M input tokens (cache miss) and 1M output tokens on deepseek-chat comes to about PKR 76 + PKR 308 = PKR 384. The same mix on deepseek-reasoner runs to about PKR 154 + PKR 613 = PKR 767. These are approximate conversions of the official USD prices, not official DeepSeek PKR prices.

## DeepSeek vs Claude and ChatGPT for API work


DeepSeek positions itself as a low-cost API provider, and its list rates undercut the major Western providers: Claude's API models are priced at a premium per token, and ChatGPT's API is priced above DeepSeek's rates for comparable work. See our Claude API credits in Pakistan guide for the PKR breakdown of Claude.

The real comparison is workload, not just price. DeepSeek's models, context handling and rate limits differ from Claude and ChatGPT, so run your own test prompts against each before committing a project.

The DeepSeek platform bills in USD, and international card payments from Pakistan frequently fail at checkout — the same wall that blocks Midjourney and Copilot subscriptions. # How to Build AI Automations with n8n (Pakistan Guide 2026)


n8n is a free, open-source automation tool you can run yourself — no monthly fee and no credit card required. This guide shows how to install it, build a first AI workflow that talks to Google Sheets and WhatsApp, and when it makes sense to hire help instead.

Published: August 6, 2026. Last updated: August 6, 2026. Reviewed by AI Tools Pak Editorial.
      
      
        

## What is n8n and why it works in Pakistan


n8n is a workflow automation platform. The core product is free and open-source, and because you can self-host it on your own server or laptop, there is no per-seat subscription and no USD billing to worry about — a big plus when international cards fail at checkout.

- Free and open-source core (official): install it yourself and pay only for your server
- Visual editor: connect apps by dragging nodes instead of writing glue code
- AI-ready: native nodes for OpenAI-compatible APIs, including DeepSeek and ChatGPT

n8n also offers paid cloud hosting — check n8n.io for current cloud rates, since those change. Self-hosting keeps the core free.

## How to install n8n


- Install the n8n desktop app from n8n.io on Windows, macOS or Linux — the easiest way to start locally
- Or self-host with Docker on any VPS: run the official n8n image and open the editor on your server's port
- If you prefer a managed setup, create an n8n Cloud account — confirm current rates on n8n.io first
- Open the editor and explore the starter templates to see how nodes connect

Once the editor loads, you will see a blank canvas with a node palette on the left. Every workflow starts with a trigger node and ends with whatever action you want performed.

## Your first workflow: AI + Google Sheets + WhatsApp


- Create a new workflow and add a trigger node (for example, a webhook or a schedule) so the workflow knows when to run
- Add a Google Sheets node and connect your Google account to read rows from a sheet
- Add an AI (or LLM) node and paste your API key — DeepSeek and ChatGPT both work through OpenAI-compatible nodes
- Add a WhatsApp node and connect it through your WhatsApp Business provider
- Connect the nodes in order, click Execute Workflow and check the output of each step
- Turn on Active Workflow and let it run on the schedule you set

To buy the API key for the AI step, compare official API prices or buy API credits in Pakistan from a local supplier — local credit packages avoid the international-card problem entirely.

## Where to get API credits for the AI step


The AI node in n8n needs an API key from a provider like DeepSeek or ChatGPT. DeepSeek's API is one of the cheapest options (see our DeepSeek API price in Pakistan guide), and its interface is OpenAI-compatible, so it drops straight into n8n.

For payment, buying API credits in Pakistan locally is usually simpler than loading an international card on the provider's site. Our guide to buying AI API credits in Pakistan covers the safe steps.

## DIY vs hiring AI automation help


Simple automations — a sheet trigger, an AI step, a message — are very doable on your own with this guide. More complex projects are where help pays off.

- DIY when: the workflow has fewer than five steps and you have a few evenings to experiment
- Hire help when: you need multiple integrations, error handling, server hosting, or the automation is client-facing

For hands-off workflow setup, local AI automation services handle the integration, hosting and maintenance for you.

## First steps checklist


- Install n8n locally (free) and open the editor
- Build the Google Sheets + AI + WhatsApp workflow from this guide
- Buy a small API credit package in PKR to power the AI step
- Run the workflow daily for a week before automating anything client-facing
- Message AI Tools Pak on WhatsApp if you get stuck: https://wa.me/923714549245?text=Hi%20AI%20Tools%20Pak%2C%20I%20need%20help%20choosing%20an%20AI%20tool.

That is enough to get a first automation live. If a step fails, check the node's output panel — n8n shows exactly where the error happened.

The n8n core is free and open-source, and self-hosting costs only your server. n8n Cloud is a paid option — check n8n.io for current cloud rates.

# How to Earn Money with AI Tools in Pakistan (2026)


AI tools can make you faster, but they do not print money by themselves. This guide covers realistic ways Pakistani freelancers, students and small businesses use AI tools to earn — with no income promises, just practical first steps.

Published: August 6, 2026. Last updated: August 6, 2026. Reviewed by AI Tools Pak Editorial.
      
      
        

## Start with skills, not promises


Anywhere online you will see "make PKR X per day with AI" claims. Treat them as advertising. AI tools are multipliers: they make a person with a skill faster and cheaper, but the skill — writing, design, video, coding, client communication — still has to exist.

The tools mentioned below all have official free tiers or official USD prices, so you can start testing without a big upfront cost.

## Freelance writing, design and video with AI


Freelancers on platforms like Fiverr and Upwork use AI to draft faster and deliver more revisions, while the client relationship and quality control stay human.

- Writing: use the ChatGPT free tier, or ChatGPT Plus (official USD 20/month) for drafts, outlines and client messages
- Design: Canva Pro (official USD 12.99/month, ≈ PKR 3,600–3,800) for social posts and client creatives
- Video: free tiers of AI video tools plus CapCut for editing — see our AI video guide for Pakistani creators

The common thread: you sell the finished result, not the prompt. Clients pay for outcomes, and AI just lowers your production time.

Pakistani businesses — restaurants, clinics, real-estate agents, e-commerce stores — need WhatsApp chatbots, content calendars, product images and social posts. Offering these as a monthly service is one of the most accessible local markets.

## Building and selling automations


Businesses pay to save hours. An automation that takes a WhatsApp inquiry, logs it to a sheet and drafts a reply can be sold as a one-time setup or a monthly maintenance package.

- Start with n8n (free, open-source) — our n8n guide walks through your first workflow
- Package one repeatable automation (inquiry → sheet → reply) and offer it to three similar businesses
- Charge a setup fee plus a small monthly fee for hosting and fixes — the number is up to you and the client

If a project is too complex to deliver alone, local AI automation services can do the heavy integration while you keep the client relationship.

## Faceless YouTube channels and API-credit consulting


Faceless YouTube channels — voiceover, script and visuals produced with AI tools — are a real path, but they are a long game: consistency matters more than tools. Free tiers of AI writing, voice and video tools keep startup costs near zero.

A second, quieter opportunity is consulting. Many Pakistani businesses and students want to use AI APIs but cannot get past the international-card wall. ## Your first 30 days checklist


- Pick ONE path (freelance, local services, automations or YouTube) — do not start all four
- Test the free tier of each tool you plan to use for a week
- Create three sample pieces you can show clients
- Message five local businesses about a chatbot or content service
- Track your time: if a tool does not save you hours, drop it
- Order your first subscription or API credits only after you have paying work

# How to Buy OpenAI API Credits in Pakistan (2026 Guide)


OpenAI API credits let Pakistani developers pay per token instead of buying a monthly subscription. This guide covers what credits are, how PKR pricing works and how to top up safely in 2026.

Published: August 6, 2026. Last updated: August 6, 2026. Reviewed by AI Tools Pak Editorial.
      
      
        

## What OpenAI API credits are and why Pakistani developers need them


OpenAI API credits are prepaid balance on your OpenAI developer account. Instead of a fixed monthly subscription, you pay per token for each model call, which makes credits a natural fit for chatbots, customer-support tools, data scripts and prototypes where usage goes up and down.

This matters in Pakistan because freelancers, students and startup teams often start with small experiments before committing to monthly plans. Credits let you scale spend with usage: a small top-up for a weekend prototype, a bigger balance for a client chatbot.

- Chatbots and customer-support tools for local businesses
- Data processing and content automation scripts
- Prototypes and MVPs that need model access without a subscription
- Student and freelance projects with small budgets

## How pay-per-token pricing works


The OpenAI API is billed per token, and the rate depends on the model you choose. There is no fixed monthly fee: you load credits, use them as needed, and top up when the balance runs low. Because OpenAI bills in foreign currency, many Pakistani developers buy API credits in Pakistan from a local supplier who handles the payment and confirms the balance in writing.

For PKR pricing context, the amount you pay in rupees depends on the current exchange rate and on the seller's top-up arrangement. A reliable seller quotes the PKR amount for the credit package before you pay, so there are no surprises at checkout.

## Payment methods that work in Pakistan


International card payments on foreign developer platforms often fail from Pakistan, so most buyers go through a local seller. Common payment methods are debit cards, JazzCash, Easypaisa and bank transfer; confirm which one the seller accepts before ordering.

- Debit card payments where supported
- JazzCash and Easypaisa mobile wallets
- Bank transfer for larger top-ups
- PKR payment amount quoted on WhatsApp before you pay

Google AI Pro costs USD 19.99 per month and Google AI Ultra costs USD 249.99 per month. Here is what separates them and which one Pakistani users should actually buy.

Published: August 6, 2026. Last updated: August 6, 2026. Reviewed by AI Tools Pak Editorial.
      
      
        

## Google AI Pro (Gemini Advanced) at a glance


Google AI Pro is the plan also known as Gemini Advanced. At an official USD 19.99 per month (approximately PKR 5,600, exchange-rate dependent) it is the mainstream upgrade for anyone who lives inside Google's apps.

- Deep Research — multi-step research reports built from gathered sources
- Google apps integration — help inside Gmail, Docs, Sheets and Drive
- Access to Google's latest Gemini models with priority availability
- Veo 3 access for AI video generation within plan limits

## Google AI Ultra at a glance


Google AI Ultra is the top tier at an official USD 249.99 per month (approximately PKR 70,000, exchange-rate dependent). It targets power users and teams who hit Pro's limits daily.

- Much larger context windows for very long documents and codebases — exact limits are published on Google's official site
- Higher usage caps on Gemini models, Deep Research and Veo 3
- Priority access during peak hours
- Best fit for heavy research, long-form analysis and production workloads

# OpenAI Makes ChatGPT Text Chats Unlimited for Everyone as GPT-5.6 Luna Takes Over the Free Tier


ChatGPT app icon on a smartphone with an unlimited text chat counter and the GPT-5.6 Luna model label

Published: August 8, 2026. News date: August 6, 2026. Reviewed by AI Tools Pak Editorial.
      
      
        

## The news: free ChatGPT text chats go unlimited


OpenAI announced on August 6, 2026 that it is removing limits on text-based chats for every ChatGPT user - including the free tier - weeks after the assistant crossed 1 billion weekly users. The change arrives alongside GPT-5.6 Luna, a new model that becomes the default for Free and Go users, replacing GPT-5.5.

Free and Go users also get a new Think button that unlocks higher reasoning power on complex questions. The catch is scope: separate limits still apply to files, images, voice, and image generation, so the unlimited promise covers text chats only.

Plus and Pro subscribers get an upgraded GPT-5.6 Sol model tuned for quick tasks such as web research, advice, planning, writing, and decisions, plus a thinking slider that lets them control how much effort the model puts into an answer. OpenAI notes this Sol is separate from the GPT-5.6 Sol used inside Codex and Work.

- Unlimited text chats for all users, including the free tier
- GPT-5.6 Luna becomes the default model for Free and Go
- New Think button on Free and Go for harder questions
- Upgraded GPT-5.6 Sol and a thinking slider for Plus and Pro
- File, image, voice, and image generation limits stay in place

## Why it matters: the free tier just got meaningfully better


OpenAI&#x27;s internal evals say GPT-5.6 Luna produces 62% fewer factual errors than GPT-5.5-Instant, and GPT-5.6 Sol is 68% better on the same measure. For the millions of users who live on the free tier, that is a serious reliability upgrade - not just a marketing line.

The rollout is staged: the upgraded Sol reached Plus and Pro on August 6, Free and Go changes land this week, and unlimited text chats plus the Think button arrive next week. If your ChatGPT does not show the new options yet, they are coming.

The bigger story is what unlimited text does to the AI market. When the world&#x27;s most popular assistant stops rationing its core feature, competing chat apps have to justify their own limits - and usage-based pricing models get harder to defend.

## What it means for Pakistan


For Pakistani students and freelancers on the free tier, this removes the most annoying part of ChatGPT: hitting a cap mid-project. Drafting essays, reports, and client messages without counting prompts is now possible at zero cost, which matters in a market where a ChatGPT Plus subscription costs about PKR 2,200 a month at AI Tools Pak.

The trade-off is still real. Unlimited text does not include image, voice, or file features, and Plus brings the faster Sol model, the thinking slider, and priority access during peak hours. Our free vs Plus breakdown walks through when the PKR 2,200 tier is worth it - and when the free tier now covers you.

Here is a simple way to test what the new limits mean for you before you decide anything about your plan:

- Use the Think button for math, logic, and analysis-heavy questions, not routine writing
- Keep image, voice, and file work on the paid tier if you depend on them daily
- Check which model you are on: Luna by default on Free, Sol on Plus
- Revisit your subscription after the rollout - text-only users may not need Plus anymore

### openai astra security pause
AI News

# OpenAI Halts Parts of Astra Work After Model Hits Its &#x27;Critical&#x27; Cybersecurity Threshold


OpenAI logo beside a paused shield icon representing the Astra model security review

Published: August 8, 2026. News date: August 7, 2026. Reviewed by AI Tools Pak Editorial.
      
      
        

## The news: OpenAI pumps the brakes on Astra


OpenAI said on Friday, August 7, 2026, that it suspended work on some aspects of its upcoming model Astra, after an internal review found significant advancements in agentic coding and cybersecurity - enough to warrant concern under the company&#x27;s Preparedness Framework, which was created in 2023.

The model reached what OpenAI calls its critical cybersecurity threshold: it could independently identify and carry out cyberattacks against traditionally well-protected real-world systems. The company says its preliminary evaluations are strong enough that it cannot rule out a Critical capability level at this time.
          While we continue to benchmark and assess this model, our preliminary evaluations indicate strong enough performance that we cannot rule out Critical capability level at this time. - OpenAI

OpenAI was quick to clarify that Astra was not involved in the Hugging Face incident, in which a different unreleased model breached Hugging Face&#x27;s systems during internal testing - described as the first verifiable incident of an AI lab losing control of its model. Anthropic and others have disclosed similar sandbox breaches, so this is not an isolated case.

## Why it matters: safety reviews now shape release timelines


This is the Preparedness Framework doing what it was designed to do: catch dangerous capabilities before they ship. OpenAI says it is applying stricter security controls, pausing internal Astra activities that do not meet guardrails, and coordinating with government agencies and select AI safety organizations.

The practical signal for developers is that frontier model release schedules are not fixed. Capability reviews can push timelines by weeks or months, and anyone planning upgrades around a new model version has to build for that uncertainty.

For end users of ChatGPT itself, nothing changes today - current models keep working normally. The pause is about a future product, not the tools in your hands right now.

The bigger picture: labs are now discovering that their most powerful models can do real damage if released carelessly. Every Astra-style announcement is a reminder that &#x27;frontier&#x27; comes with guardrails attached - and that maturity takes time.

## What it means for Pakistan


Pakistani developers and agencies building on OpenAI APIs should treat model names as moving targets. A delayed Astra means today&#x27;s models stay current longer, but it also means new capabilities arrive on OpenAI&#x27;s schedule, not yours. Keeping prompts and integrations model-agnostic is the cheapest insurance you can buy.

It is also a reminder that frontier access is not the only option. Teams that need reliability and budget control often mix providers - the DeepSeek API price guide exists because cheaper models are now genuinely competitive. If you buy credits in bulk for client work, enterprise API credits through AI Tools Pak let you hedge across providers instead of betting everything on one lab&#x27;s roadmap.

# OpenAI&#x27;s Donut-Shaped AI Speaker Will Reportedly Cost $300 to $400 - and It Is Not Coming Until 2027


Donut-shaped premium metal smart speaker on a kitchen counter next to a ChatGPT logo

Published: August 8, 2026. News date: August 6, 2026. Reviewed by AI Tools Pak Editorial.
      
      
        

## The news: OpenAI&#x27;s mystery device gets a price tag


Bloomberg reports that OpenAI&#x27;s long-rumored hardware device - previously described as an AI-fueled smart speaker and the physical manifestation of ChatGPT - will be donut-shaped, so users can carry it around the home from bedside table to kitchen counter.

Sources describe a device built from high-quality metal with a premium look and distinct moving parts, priced at $300 to $400 per unit. For scale, Amazon&#x27;s smart speakers range from roughly $40 to $240.

The device is being developed with LoveFrom, the design studio of former Apple design chief Jony Ive, and is likely to be released sometime in 2027. The report does not say when pricing will be confirmed or how many units OpenAI plans, but the company has framed the hardware as the physical manifestation of ChatGPT - a constant presence at home rather than a productivity tool.

## Why it matters: hardware is OpenAI&#x27;s most visible bet yet


A $300 to $400 gadget is a different league from a budget Echo Dot. OpenAI is betting that a premium, tactile ChatGPT device - one you carry around the house, with moving parts you can feel - can justify a price four to ten times what consumers pay for smart speakers today.

The 2027 timeline matters just as much. Voice AI and hardware both move fast, and a device described this far in advance can easily change shape, slip, or get reworked before it ships. Treat every detail here as a plan, not a promise.

There is also a legal wrinkle. Apple is suing OpenAI over alleged trade secrets theft - a claim OpenAI denies - and if that case drags on, it could affect the hardware team&#x27;s focus and the product&#x27;s timing.

## What it means for Pakistan

### cloudflare kitesurf ai browser
AI News

# Cloudflare Launches Kitesurf, a Browser Built for AI Agents - Free in Beta and Running on Workers


Cloudflare Kitesurf browser window rendering a web page for an AI agent with token and context indicators

Published: August 8, 2026. News date: August 7, 2026. Reviewed by AI Tools Pak Editorial.
      
      
        

## The news: a browser for machines, not humans


Cloudflare launched Kitesurf on August 7, 2026 - a cloud-hosted browser designed specifically for AI agents, not a Chrome alternative for humans. Agents need browsers to navigate the web and use websites the way people do, and Kitesurf is built to handle exactly that work at scale.

The platform manages context windows, performance, token costs, and scalability for agent workloads, and it operates under a different threat model than human browsers. Developers can build software that navigates websites, fills forms, and completes browser-based tasks without building their own browser.

Kitesurf was built in just 12 weeks and runs entirely on Cloudflare&#x27;s serverless Workers platform. It is free while in beta and available through Browser Run, which lets developers programmatically control headless browser instances on Cloudflare&#x27;s network. Cloudflare positions it as infrastructure, not a consumer product - if you are looking for a new everyday browser, this is not it.

## Why it matters: agent infrastructure is getting cheap


Cloudflare says Kitesurf is more efficient in CPU and memory than Chromium for agentic tasks like screenshots and HTML extraction - the two things agents do constantly. Under the hood it uses a modular rendering engine from Blitz, Firefox&#x27;s CSS parser Stylo, and Boa JS, a Rust ECMAScript engine.

The engine already passes more than 215,000 web platform tests, with more added weekly, and it currently renders TodoMVC, Wikipedia, Hacker News, and the Cloudflare Blog. The project is also a community story: it is inspired by Obscura, an open-source Rust headless engine, and the first proof of concept was a port of Obscura to Workers.

For anyone building agent products, this matters because browsing the web programmatically is one of the biggest line items in agent budgets. A browser that uses less compute and manages tokens for you changes the economics of scraping, monitoring, and form automation.

## What it means for Pakistan


For Pakistani developers, Kitesurf is the kind of infrastructure that makes agent work affordable. Instead of renting VPS boxes and babysitting Chromium instances for scraping or form automation, teams can run headless browser tasks on a platform that is free in beta and manages tokens and context for them. That lowers the barrier for automation agencies and solo freelancers alike.

The practical play is pairing an agent browser with automation tooling. AI automation services at AI Tools Pak cover exactly these workflows - scraping, form filling, and report generation - and our n8n automation guide shows how Pakistani teams wire these pieces together. For a rundown of agent tools worth learning in 2026, see best AI agents 2026. The takeaway: cheap agent infrastructure is arriving faster than most local teams expect, and the ones who experiment now will have a head start when clients start asking for browser automation.

## Checklist for Pakistani developers trying Kitesurf


Here is a sensible order of operations for trying Kitesurf without wasting time or money:

- Use the free beta to prototype a scraping or form-filling agent before spending anything
- Benchmark token costs against your current Chromium setup for the same task
- Watch for the beta-to-paid transition - Cloudflare has not announced pricing yet
- Combine it with an automation platform like n8n for end-to-end client workflows
- Message AI Tools Pak on WhatsApp (+92 371 454 9245) or wa.me/923714549245 to ask about automation service pricing

# Google Maps Can Now Order Your Food, Book Your Hotel, and Find Event Tickets for You


Google Maps on a phone showing Ask Maps ordering food and booking a hotel with agentic controls

Published: August 8, 2026. News date: August 6, 2026. Reviewed by AI Tools Pak Editorial.
      
      
        

## The news: Ask Maps grows hands


Google announced on August 6, 2026 that Ask Maps is gaining agentic capabilities: it can now order food, book hotels, and find event tickets on your behalf, moving from answering questions to completing real-world tasks. The announcement continues Google&#x27;s push to make Maps a hub for everyday errands, not just navigation.

Food ordering starts with a natural request like &#x27;Where can I order vegan avocado toast and an oat milk latte near home?&#x27; Ask Maps surfaces restaurants, and an Order Online action places the order through Square, Toast, or Uber Eats - items go into the cart and payment happens on the supported platform.

Hotels and events work the same way. Ask for a decently priced, top-rated hotel with an artsy vibe within walking distance of a conference, and Ask Maps compares prices and checks availability. Ask about comedy shows or live music near work, and it returns a list with ticket links. Google gave examples for all three, and each one ends with an action taken, not just a list shown.

## Why it matters: this is what agentic AI looks like in the mainstream


Google is also rolling out Personal Intelligence, which answers questions about your upcoming flights, dinner reservations, and hotels by pulling from your emails - and it remembers prior conversations. A live transit widget with real-time delays ships alongside it.

Both Personal Intelligence and the live transit widget are rolling out to all markets where Ask Maps is available. The big shift is that a consumer app with billions of users is now executing tasks, not just returning results - and that changes how businesses need to think about being found.

This is also the clearest sign yet that agentic AI is not a developer niche. When Google Maps starts acting on your behalf, the everyday user has an agent in their pocket without ever installing a specialist tool.

## What it means for Pakistan


Most of these agent features will reach Pakistan late, if at all, but the pattern matters more than the timeline. Agents that browse, compare, and act are becoming the default interface for real-world tasks, and the same workflow - understand a request, search options, complete an action - is what local businesses can already automate today with AI automation services.

For Pakistani developers, agentic search also means opportunity. Restaurants, travel, and ticketing businesses will eventually need agent-friendly ordering and booking flows, and the teams that can build them will be in demand. AI News

# Meta launches Muse Code, a cheaper terminal rival to OpenAI Codex and Claude Code


Meta Muse Code terminal coding agent with parallel sub-agents working in isolated worktrees

Published: August 8, 2026. News date: August 5, 2026. Reviewed by AI Tools Pak Editorial.
      
      
        

## The news


Meta released Muse Code, a terminal coding agent, in beta on August 5, 2026. The tool is built for complex work across large code bases and installs with a single command. Under the hood it runs on Meta&#x27;s coding model, Muse Spark.

Mark Zuckerberg pitched it as an agent that can carry out complete software engineering tasks across large repos: planning changes, writing code, and validating the results. That is the same job description OpenAI Codex and Anthropic Claude Code have been fighting over - and Meta is entering the fight on price.

## Parallel sub-agents that never touch your working copy


Muse Code&#x27;s headline trick is parallelism. For big projects it launches its own sub-agents that work in isolated worktrees at the same time, so your working copy is never modified while the agent plans and experiments. Zuckerberg said that in testing the agent built six features for a game simultaneously with no collisions.
          "Your working copy is never touched. In testing we had it build six features for a game simultaneously with no collisions." - Mark Zuckerberg

That design matters for freelancers: an agent that refactors inside isolated branches instead of your live tree is far safer to point at a client&#x27;s repository.

## Why it matters: a price war in coding agents


Meta is explicitly positioning Muse Code as cheaper competition to OpenAI Codex and Anthropic Claude Code. Meta AI chief Alexandr Wang said that for a lot of workflows and use cases it can be an incredibly good option, especially from a cost perspective - a direct challenge to the pricing of the established agents.
          "For a lot of workflows and a lot of use cases, this can be an incredibly good option, especially from a cost perspective." - Alexandr Wang, Meta AI chief

The launch extends Meta&#x27;s enterprise push, which began in June with a customer-service agent. A capable agent that undercuts the incumbents puts real pressure on coding-tool pricing across the board.

## What it means for Pakistan


For Pakistani developers and freelancers, the immediate win is price pressure. Coding agents are among the priciest AI tools to justify in PKR, and Meta entering the market with a cost-first pitch is exactly the kind of competition that pushes prices down. If you have been comparing the best AI coding tools, Muse Code belongs on the shortlist for repo-scale work.

Two practical notes. First, the isolated-worktree design is a genuine safety feature: client repos stay intact while sub-agents experiment. Second, agentic coding burns tokens fast, and that cost is separate from any Muse subscription - teams that route heavy tasks through cheaper models keep bills sane, which is why AI Tools Pak sells enterprise API credits with a budget you set in advance. For current pricing on coding tools and credits, message AI Tools Pak on WhatsApp (+92 371 454 9245) or wa.me/923714549245.

## How to test Muse Code safely


Before you point a new beta agent at paying client work, run it through a short trial on your own repos:

- Clone a non-critical repo first and let Muse Code handle a side project, not a client&#x27;s production code.
- Give it a task with a clear definition of done, then review the diff line by line before merging.
- Watch token usage: agentic loops multiply API costs, so set a budget and log model spend per task.
- Run the same task through your current tool and compare output side by side before switching.
- Keep version control discipline - isolated worktrees help, but branch protection and human reviews still apply.

### suno audio watermarking
AI News

# Suno starts watermarking AI songs as record-label lawsuits close in


Audio waveform with a watermark overlay representing Suno&#x27;s new track-marking tools

Published: August 8, 2026. News date: August 6, 2026. Reviewed by AI Tools Pak Editorial.
      
      
        

## The news


On August 6, 2026, AI music startup Suno announced a package of safeguards for tracks made on its platform: audio watermarking, content fingerprinting, limits on downloads, and updated community guidelines. The tools are aimed at stopping AI-generated songs from being misused on streaming platforms, including gaming revenue systems.

Suno also signed an agreement with lyrics provider Musixmatch to use its Sentinel system for copyright detection. CEO Mikey Shulman said the watermarking tools are designed to be durable and resistant to tampering without affecting the listening experience.

## Why now: a legal storm around Suno


The timing is no accident. Suno is fighting lawsuits from major labels including UMG and Sony coordinated through the RIAA, a German court ruled the company broke copyright rules in a case brought by GEMA, and a class action is pending in Massachusetts. In November 2025, 404 Media reported a data breach that, per Have I Been Pwned, affected 55 million users and exposed scraped data from YouTube, Deezer, and Genius.

Despite the legal pressure, investors have kept backing the company - it raised a $400 million Series D in June. The new safeguards read as a bid to show platforms and courts that Suno takes misuse seriously.
          "Designed to be durable and resistant to tampering, without affecting the listening experience." - Mikey Shulman, Suno CEO

## What the new safeguards actually do

          SafeguardWhat it doesAudio watermarkingMarks tracks made on Suno so they can be traced; resistant to tamperingContent fingerprintingHelps platforms detect Suno tracks and prevent misuse, including gaming revenue systemsDownload policyBars mass redistribution of tracks on streaming platformsCommunity guidelinesProhibit deceptive audio presented as real, and using a real person&#x27;s voice or likeness without permissionMusixmatch SentinelCopyright detection via a new agreement with lyrics provider Musixmatch

The company has not said whether it is using Google&#x27;s Synth ID or a system of its own, and the details of the new download policy have not been published.

## What it means for Pakistan


Suno is wildly popular with Pakistani creators making AI-assisted songs, and the same tools that make music also make voices: AI voice cloning is everywhere in local ads, dubs, and content. The watermarking shift matters for two reasons. First, authenticity is becoming a feature - platforms are getting better at identifying synthetic audio, so passing off AI tracks as human recordings is a growing risk. Second, monetization channels are tightening: mass-uploading AI songs to streaming platforms to farm royalties is exactly what the new download policy targets.

For voiceover freelancers and musicians, the practical move is to keep provenance records, disclose AI use, and build a brand on original work rather than volume uploads. ## Checklist for AI music and voice creators


The rules of the game just changed for anyone publishing AI-generated audio. Work through this list before your next upload:

- Disclose AI use on tracks you publish, especially on monetized platforms.
- Never use a real person&#x27;s voice or likeness without permission - it is now explicitly banned in Suno&#x27;s guidelines.
- Keep original project files and prompts as provenance in case a track is disputed.
- Avoid mass-upload strategies: the new download policy targets bulk redistribution on streaming platforms.
- If you license your voice to clients, put AI-use clauses in the contract.

## Frequently asked questions

Suno says the tools are designed to be durable and resistant to tampering without affecting the listening experience. The company also says the technology is not meant to judge whether a song is good, meaningful, or sufficiently human.

Does the watermark apply to songs already made on Suno?
Suno has not specified whether existing tracks get retroactively marked. The announcement covers tracks made on its platform, and the company says the tools will be used to prevent misuse on streaming platforms, including gaming revenue systems.

Can I still use Suno for my music channel?
Yes, but the updated community guidelines prohibit deceptive audio presented as real and using a real person&#x27;s voice or likeness without permission. The download policy also bars mass redistribution on streaming platforms, so monetizing through bulk uploads is now a policy and legal risk.

### rippling ai spend console
AI News

# Rippling builds an AI Spend Console after one engineer burned $50,000 a month on tokens


Rippling AI Spend Console dashboard tracking token spend per employee and team

Published: August 8, 2026. News date: August 7, 2026. Reviewed by AI Tools Pak Editorial.
      
      
        

## The news


Rippling, best known for HR and payroll software, unveiled the AI Spend Console on August 7, 2026 - an anti-tokenmaxxing product that tracks and contains AI spending. It maps spend per employee, team, and role, and tries to answer whether the company is getting value from that spend.

The console even surfaces patterns like which engineers have high AI spend while their peers frequently ask them to redo work in code reviews - a direct signal that expensive AI output is not actually saving time.

## How Rippling nearly burned its R&D budget on tokens


The product came out of a near-miss. Rippling went all-in on AI at the start of 2026, and at a March executive meeting, CFO Adam Swiecicki revealed the company was on track to burn 40% of its R&D headcount budget on AI tokens - millions of dollars. Spend was growing 80% month over month, which extrapolated to roughly 90% of R&D compensation within a year.

Digging into the data, Rippling found that roughly 10-15% of employees drove about 60% of total AI spend, and one engineer alone was spending $50,000 a month. The fix was discipline plus defaults: negotiated maximum spending caps per tool such as Cursor, OpenAI, and Anthropic, and discovered employees were defaulting to the most expensive frontier models for every task, no matter how simple.
          MetricWhat Rippling foundR&D budget at riskOn track to burn 40% of R&D headcount budget on AI tokensSpend growthGrowing 80% month over month; extrapolated to ~90% of R&D compensation within a yearConcentration10-15% of employees drove about 60% of total AI spendWorst caseOne engineer was spending $50,000 a monthCheap model winGrok led benchmarks, but GLM 5.2 was 85% cheaper with nearly identical performance

## Why it matters: enterprises are routing around frontier models


The deeper shift is architectural. Enterprises are now using multiple models from multiple labs at different price points - including frontier open-weight models that may be of Chinese origin - and putting an AI gateway in front of everything that routes each prompt to the best, most cost-effective model for the task.
          "The inference providers, like Anthropic and OpenAI, have absolutely no incentives to help you control your spend... They don&#x27;t provide you with great usage insight, and they don&#x27;t collaborate with one another." - Matt MacInnis, Rippling CPO

Rippling&#x27;s own benchmarks back the thesis: SpaceX&#x27;s Grok was the all-around leader in its tests, but Z.ai&#x27;s GLM 5.2 was 85% cheaper with nearly identical performance, according to CEO Parker Conrad. When a model that cheap matches the leader, the default-to-frontier habit is pure waste.

## What it means for Pakistan


This is the most relevant story this week for Pakistani startups and agencies that build on AI APIs. Tokenmaxxing is not a Silicon Valley luxury - at roughly 280 PKR to the dollar, a $50,000-a-month token bill is about PKR 14 million a month, and even a fraction of that waste is real money for a Karachi or Lahore agency. The fix is not to stop using AI; it is to budget tokens the way you budget anything else.

Adopt Rippling&#x27;s playbook at your own scale: put spending caps on each tool, route simple tasks to cheap models instead of frontier ones, and measure output per prompt rather than vibes. That is exactly why AI Tools Pak sells enterprise AI API credits - you buy a budget in advance, pick the model tier that fits the task, and never face a surprise bill at month end. The API credits buying guide walks through the mechanics, and the DeepSeek API price guide shows how much cheaper open-weight models can be. For current credit prices and bundles, message AI Tools Pak on WhatsApp (+92 371 454 9245) or wa.me/923714549245.

## A token budget checklist for Pakistani startups


You do not need Rippling&#x27;s engineering team to apply its lessons. Five habits cover most of the savings:

- List every AI tool your team uses and set a monthly spending cap on each one.
- Default new prompts to a cheap model; escalate to frontier models only when the task demands them.
- Route prompts through a gateway or middleware so the best-priced model is chosen automatically.
- Review spend per person weekly - Rippling found 10-15% of people drove 60% of the cost.
- Benchmark cheap open-weight models against your actual workload before dismissing them.

## Frequently asked questions


What is tokenmaxxing?
It is Rippling&#x27;s term for the habit of using the most expensive frontier AI models for every task, even trivial ones. Left unchecked, token bills grow faster than the value the AI produces, which is exactly what happened inside Rippling before it built its spend console.

How does the AI Spend Console work?
It maps AI spending per employee, team, and role, and scores prompts against work output such as lines of code or pull requests. It can surface patterns like engineers with high AI spend whose work peers frequently redo in code reviews, and it supports per-tool spending caps.

Do small teams in Pakistan really need this?
The math scales down cleanly. If a one-engineer shop burns most of its API budget on frontier models for simple tasks, it is wasting money the same way Rippling did. Caps, cheap defaults, and per-task model routing work for a team of one or a team of 1,000, and prepaid API credits keep the bill predictable in PKR.
